text:
sam: Nightly eval alerted — rewrite/noise metric on the 'policy-examples' promptset jumped ~5x in the 03/19 run. Sample failures show list items being rephrased into unrelated sentences. Poking logs now.
ci-bot: Nightly run #2026-03-19 complete: redwood-open-7b:v2-quant-int8-packedkv-2026-03-19 — metrics: rewrite_rate=0.19 (prev 0.04), ROUGE-drop=0.07. See: https://ci/redwood/nightly/2901234567
adina: Is this only on the quantized build or also on fp16/bf16? Any recent tokenizer or preprocessing PRs? @sam
sam: It's on the int8 packedKV quant build. bf16 run looks fine (rewrite_rate=0.03). Model tag: redwood-open-7b:v2-quant-int8-packedkv-2026-03-19. I pulled a few generation examples into the thread below.
matt: Can you paste a short before/after example (good vs bad) and the exact build diff? Want to see where behavior changed.
sam: Good vs bad snippet:
```
Prompt: "Convert the following bullets to a short summary:\n- keep logs\n- rotate keys\n- test canary"
Good (fp16): "Summary: keep logs, rotate keys, and enable canary tests."
Bad (int8): "Summary: Keep logs rotating in the night. The system will test the canary and then sing."  // obviously hallucinated rewrite
```
Diff from last good build (high-level): packedKV stride adjustment + new token-normalizer v1.3.2 landed in the tokenizer pipeline.
adina: Token-normalizer v1.3.2 changed how trailing punctuation and colon-separated lists are normalized (PR: https://git/redwood/tokenizer/pulls/421). Could map trailing ':' -> separate token now. That might impact KV alignment.
li: Observed pattern: failures mostly when prompt ends with a colon or a trailing dash; also longer lists (>3 items). Short prompts unaffected. So sequence-length + punctuation combo seems likely.
matt: Quant kernels also had a micro-patch yesterday to pack KV with stride=4 instead of stride=3 for int8 on A100. If stride changed, indices can misalign with tokenizer token boundaries -> subtle attention drift.
sam: Reproduced locally with unit binary. Command I used:
```
./run_eval --model redwood-open-7b:v2-quant-int8-packedkv-2026-03-19 --promptset policy-examples --seed 42 --dump-attn=attn.json
```
Output shows EOS probs unusually low and token-reorder at step ~24.
ci-bot: Quick compare: nightly-bf16 vs nightly-int8 stacktrace attached. Unit tests passed: tokenizer unit, runtime smoke. Only long-sequence promptset failing in nightly.
matt: Can someone dump attention maps for a failing case? I'm curious if prefix tokens lose attention mass to punctuation tokens.
li: Pasted condensed attention snapshot (token idx -> top attended idx):
```
0:[0,1,2]
1:[0,2,3]
10:[9,2,25]
23:[5,999]  <-- weird 999 index shows up when packedKV stride mismatch triggers out-of-bound aliasing in int8 packed buffer
```
adina: 999 aliasing is a smoking gun for packing index overflow. Looks like packedKV stride change produced an index computation bug in the int8 path. That would explain only quant builds failing.
sam: Agreed. Proposed immediate actions:
- rollback quant build to previous packedKV stride (hotfix release). ✅ (sam)
- add targeted failing test to nightly that includes colon-terminated lists and >3 items (matt)
- add a gating rule: int8 packedKV builds must pass promptset 'policy-examples' with rewrite_rate < 0.06 before promotion (adina)
- run a narrow canary of the fixed quant build (ops-bot)
ops-bot: Canary plan: deploy hotfix quant build to 5% of production traffic and to one dedicated canary pool. Monitor rewrite_rate, ROUGE, and EOS-prob delta for first 24h. Automatic rollback if rewrite_rate > 0.06 or EOS-prob drops > 0.03.
matt: I'll add the failing test and a dedicated CI job that runs it against new quant PRs. Will include a reproducer and an attention-map sanity check.
adina: Also adding a tokenizer post-deploy check: for any tokenizer change, run normalization regression on a small corpus of prompts that include trailing punctuation/list patterns. If any diff in tokenization of those prompts, block automatic quant promotion.
li: Additional mitigation: in runtime, add a temporary safety that detects improbable attention indices (> vocab_size*2) in packed buffers and reverts to slower compatible path for that request. Low risk, temporary.
sam: I'll push the rollback now and open a postmortem doc template. Assigning tasks:
- sam: rollback and hotfix rollout (ETA 2h)
- matt: CI failing test + reproducer (ETA 6h)
- adina: gating rule PR (ETA 4h)
- li: runtime index check (ETA 12h)
- ops-bot: canary schedule (scheduled)
matt: One more: let's add a metric alert for sudden delta in EOS probability distribution in nightly-eval dashboard to catch this earlier.
adina: Good call. I'll add the alert.
sam: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after hotfix canary metrics. Filing follow-up thread in #incidents if rollback triggers any user-facing error. :thumbsup:
adina: TL;DR plan: rollback quant packedKV stride change -> add promptset gate + CI test + tokenizer normalization check + runtime safety -> canary -> promote once green. Closing for now.
